title: Worker Handoff
description: Bounded packet identifying one Worker attempt. Carries paths and hashes, never copies of documents.
$comment: Every property appears in required at every level, matching the strict structured-output rules the result contracts must follow. Optional fields are nullable, never absent, so a Worker never has to guess whether a missing key means empty or unset.

mode.description: Role-specific operating mode. discovery uses challenge. planner uses plan-write. implementer uses build. reviewer uses plan-check, audit, initial, incremental, or final.

worktree.description: Absolute root the Worker operates in. After approval this is the Run's isolated worktree. Before approval, and for an audit, no worktree exists yet: it is the primary checkout, and the read-only tool boundary is what keeps it safe.

baseSha.description: The commit the work is anchored to. After approval, the immutable SHA the worktree was created from. Before approval, the observed HEAD. Null in Greenfield Mode before the bootstrap commit exists, which is the only case where there is no commit to name.

snapshotHash.description: SHA-256 of the subject at handoff time, reused to detect that it changed under the Worker. For plan-check this is the plan hash, because the plan is the subject. Null in Greenfield Mode before the bootstrap commit, when there is no tree to hash.

taskIds.description: Plan task identifiers this attempt owns. Empty for read-only roles that own no task.

writeSet.description: Paths this attempt may modify. Empty means read-only.

artifacts.description: Canonical documents the Worker must read from disk.

pendingFindingIds.description: Findings this attempt must address. Null outside remediation and delta review.

reviewPurpose.description: Disambiguates the incremental mode, which serves two situations. task-delivery reviews one task's completed work for the first time. remediation re-reviews a subject whose findings were just corrected. Null for every non-incremental mode.

reviewerRole.description: Which reviewer this is. Product and technical reviewers own different lenses; a sole audit reviewer owns all of them. Null for non-review roles.

ownedLenses.description: Exactly the lenses this reviewer must account for in lensOutcomes. Without it, a reviewer cannot know whether a lens it did not examine was someone else's job or its own omission.

previousSubjectHash.description: The subject this one is a delta from, so an incremental review has a baseline it did not have to guess. Null on a first review.

taskId.description: The task this attempt belongs to. Scopes findings so two parallel tasks cannot collide on a shared finding id.

notes.description: Correction notes carried forward from the previous attempt of the same role. Binding for the rest of that session.

validationCommands.description: Required Project Profile commands relevant to this attempt. Null for roles that run none.
